preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 3 and 200,000.
The number of queries is between 1 and 200,000.
Each edge connects two vertices within the range of 1 to N.
Each query vertex is within the range of 1 to N.
The starting vertex of each query is not a leaf vertex.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the maximum length of a *cool* sequence from P_i to Q_i
postconditions.description: The output for each query is the maximum possible length of a *cool* sequence starting from P_i and ending at Q_i.
